summary.value: My hands-on outputs from the workshops I attended at Web Summer Camp 2026 - one playground per half-day workshop, collected in a single repo so the learning survives the conference.

content.value:
What's inside

Web Summer Camp is built around serious half-day workshops, and the only way to make those stick is to keep the code. This repo collects my hands-on outputs from the sessions I attended across the tracks - each in its own folder with notes on what the workshop covered and what I took away from it.

Why it exists

Conference learning has a half-life of about two weeks unless you turn it into something executable. Collecting the playgrounds in one repo means I can revisit any of them - and anyone curious about a workshop can see what it actually produced.
